title: SNAP: Speaker Nulling for Artifact Projection in Speech Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2603.20686v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in text-to-speech technologies enable generating high-fidelity synthetic speech nearly indistinguishable from real human voices. While recent studies show the efficacy of self-supervised learning-based speech encoders for deepfake detection, these models struggle to generalize across unseen speakers. Our quantitative analysis suggests these encoder representations are substantially influenced by speaker information, causing detectors to exploit speaker-specific correlations rather than artifact-related cues. We call this phenomenon speaker entanglement. To mitigate this reliance, we introduce SNAP, a speaker-nulling framework. We estimate a speaker subspace and apply orthogonal projection to suppress speaker-dependent components, isolating synthesis artifacts within the residual features. translated_title: SNAP：用于语音深度伪造检测中伪影投影的说话人置零方法
translated_abstract: 近年来文本转语音技术的进步使得生成与真人语音几乎难以区分的高保真合成语音成为可能。尽管近期研究表明基于自监督学习的语音编码器在深度伪造检测中的有效性，但这些模型难以泛化到未见过的说话人。我们的定量分析表明，这些编码器表征在很大程度上受说话人信息的影响，导致检测器利用说话人特有的相关性而非与伪影相关的线索。我们将这一现象称为“说话人纠缠”。为了减轻这种依赖，我们提出了SNAP——一个说话人置零框架。我们估计一个说话人子空间并应用正交投影来抑制与说话人相关的成分，从而在残差特征中分离出合成伪影。通过减少说话人纠缠，SNAP促使检测器专注于与伪影相关的模式，从而实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: 本文提出SNAP框架，通过估计说话人子空间并施加正交投影来抑制语音编码器表征中的说话人信息（即“说话人纠缠”现象），使深度伪造检测器专注于合成伪影相关特征，从而显著提升对未见说话人的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: SNAP is a speaker-nulling framework that estimates a speaker subspace and applies orthogonal projection to suppress speaker-dependent components, mitigating "speaker entanglement" in speech encoders so that deepfake detectors focus on synthesis artifacts and generalize better to unseen speakers.
